findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: download_resource, find_examples, generate_scaffold, get_sample_data, reporting_guide, sdk_guide, submit_feedback · Private data: analyze_record, download_resource, find_examples, get_capabilities, get_sample_data, mapping_workflow, submit_feedback · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: download_resource, generate_scaffold, get_sample_data, mapping_workflow, reporting_guide, sdk_guide, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: download_resource, find_examples, generate_scaffold, get_sample_data, reporting_guide, sdk_guide, submit_feedback · Private data: analyze_record, download_resource, find_examples, get_capabilities, get_sample_data, mapping_workflow, submit_feedback · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: download_resource, generate_scaffold, get_sample_data, mapping_workflow, reporting_guide, sdk_guide, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
